slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_waste
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the primary goal of the cutting plan: minimize the number of raw steel bars used, minimize total offcut waste, or minimize total cost?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included minimizing total offcut waste as an option.

slot_scores.name: exact_demand_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Must the plan produce exactly 90 pieces of 3m and 60 pieces of 4m, or is it acceptable to produce fewer pieces if it reduces waste?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether the required piece counts are exact or whether fewer pieces are acceptable.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 and P1 hidden slots were explicitly resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved the objective and exact-demand hidden slots, then stopped appropriately with no unresolved P0/P1 issues.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
